name: Vegaøyan – The Vega Archipelago
description: The Vega Archipelago is a scattering of small islands in the Norwegian Sea, just south of the Arctic Circle in Nordland. For some 1,500 years, islanders fished, farmed and gathered soft down from nesting eider ducks, with women playing a key role. You can still see fishing villages, quays, lighthouses and tiny eider houses built for the birds.
